name: closeyourit-angular-22-proof
//: zod 4.6.5 has a known flaw (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5), fixed from 4.6.6. It comes from @angular/cli
22.2.1, which requires it exactly: development tool only, it does not end up in the example's build
nor in the published package. 4.6.6 only changes the patch number and declares no dependencies, so
it is forced with an override. @angular/cli 22.2.3 already requires 4.6.6: when the example moves
to Angular 22.2.3 or later the zod override must be removed. See CYJS-68.
